title: 147871567 - 42-t-1127712-20060476F-001-001-2013
doc_notes: This document is a collection of correspondence and articles related to the 'Roswell Declaration' petition, including a MUFON Journal issue that provides a detailed debunking of the Roswell incident as a crashed UFO.

incidents.summary: Recovery of material alleged to be of extraterrestrial origin in the southwestern desert of the United States.
incidents.explanation: The material was from an ML-307 radar reflector used in Project Mogul.
incidents.quote: It involved the recovery by the U.S. Military of material alleged to be of extraterrestrial origin.
